Here the assistant is both Code Executor and Problem Solver, but they didn't separate. Might be considered disobey role spec. However the trace shows they treat themselves as multiple agents but they themselves produce all outputs. That could be considered role spec violation. I'd mark yes.

Also maybe Unaware of Termination Conditions? They keep suggesting next speaker after step_03, step_04-06 repeated. They didn't stop after solution found. But they did finish with final answer eventually. Not major.
